run_eval_retrieval: run the VILBERT retrieval evaluation script with pretrained model checkpoint and task IDs
load_dataset_eval: load evaluation datasets and dataloaders for VILBERT retrieval tasks
load_losses: load loss functions for specified VILBERT multi-task evaluation tasks
create_vilbert_model: create a VILBertForVLTasks model from pretrained checkpoint for multi-task visual-language tasks
create_pretraining_model: create a BertForMultiModalPreTraining model for zero-shot retrieval evaluation
